ownerSession.name: claw_session
ownerSession.description: Signed password session or direct trusted-network owner session. Local bootstrap/API bearer tokens cannot authorize financial changes. Cookie mutations require the CSRF header.

agentTaskToken.name: x-agent-task-token
agentTaskToken.description: Task-scoped token given to CLI workers in CLAW_EMPIRE_TASK_TOKEN. Valid 8 hours, only while the task is in progress and assigned to that agent, and only from this machine.
